received_works.body:
Hello! The way you draw clothing so cool and stylish and I was wondering if you could you draw my Cat/shark Character some fashionable new clothes? He is confident  and a bit of a show off. 
The colors and style are up to you but I would prefer for him to show some fur

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_3nhgpGLkyp6XAE05ES8XPfv7N-bEqFp/view?usp=drivesdk

Hello again! I hope you are doing well!

If it's okay, i'd like to ask you to draw my OC again! This time, i would be happy if you could draw him in his birdwatching outfit. His hobby is birdwatching and bird photography, so i'd be happy if the artwork could have a relaxed atmosphere.

The clothing references can be found here:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LukVhh33UrZynfiPhNAI-AxfSncDar3E
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Fx5tMvz6PcBARM8SaAAQuiomByiWBwSV

If it's possible, perhaps you could also include this duck in the artwork? She's an abandoned duck i used to look after, though she passed away a while ago.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/128hW7RkG_YQEn7zFS3ANAeEnCFUY1edO?usp=drive_link

Please feel free to draw him however you like. Feel free to make changes to the clothing design if you want to.

Thank you for always making such wonderful artwork. I truly appreciate it!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1H7fei7bcZfHq1zhRqoOyLGrB7fWaVVsH

Hello again! I hope you're doing well!

I hope it's okay if i ask you to draw my OC again! I'm always really happy with how you draw him, and your artwork is always fantastic.

Please feel free to draw him however you'd like! You can choose the clothes and hairstyle!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NxgtBdjzMlOtUMPjzF9iU5zWkAyGMlSI

Hello again! I also noticed that you are really good at outfit designs.
Can you design clothes for my character?
.
He is a cat. So I hope you can make his ears shorter, also make his face more likely a cat than the last time.
.
I am wondering if you can make fashionable and stylish clothes for him. Colors and styles are up to you, just make it fit well.
Thank you so much!

Hello again! 

I hope it's okay if i make another request, even if it hasn't been very long since my previous request! 

This time, i was wondering if you could draw my OC in winter clothes! Something stylish and fashionable, but warm. Your clothing designs are always so stylish, so please feel free to be creative and have fun with the design!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NxgtBdjzMlOtUMPjzF9iU5zWkAyGMlSI

Hello! I hope you are doing well!

Is it okay if i ask you to draw my OC again? I always love your artwork, and i'm always happy with the way you draw him! So if you're not too busy, i would be happy if you could draw him again!

This time, i have no specific requests for clothing, so you can choose the clothes. So please feel free to draw him however you'd like!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NxgtBdjzMlOtUMPjzF9iU5zWkAyGMlSI

Hello again! I hope you are doing well!

I've always been very happy with the previous art you have made for me! I hope it's okay if i ask you to draw my OC again! If you're tired of drawing the same character, it's okay to turn down the request.

This time, i have a specific outfit idea in mind.

Specifically, i would like an outfit inspired by Liquid Snake in Metal Gear Solid. Of course, for copyright reasons, it does not need to be the same outfit. However, it has some key elements that i like!

Specifically, wearing a heavy trenchcoat, without wearing a shirt underneath. It gives a feeling that is both dangerous and somewhat militaristic, yet also unprofessional. Ideally, it should be a heavy and plain-colored coat, and not the typical camouflage coat my OC sometimes wears.

Of course, you have complete freedom to get creative with the design! Please draw him however you like!

Here is a reference of the clothes:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1dEBxMHGyREQDKN_pajZUmWhAQsTGDQD1

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NxgtBdjzMlOtUMPjzF9iU5zWkAyGMlSI

Hello again! The previous artwork you made for me was amazing! Your fashion sense is incredible, so may i ask you to create another outfit for my arctic fox?

This time, feel free to draw him in any clothes you'd like. I only have one request for the clothes. If possible, please have him wear a cowboy hat! Ideally, there should be holes cut in the hat for his ears.

If possible, give him really long hair this time!

Other than that, please have fun with the design! I trust your skill, and i look forward to seeing more of your beautiful artwork.

If you are too busy, or if you are not interested, it is okay to refuse the request.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1C2_gWV9MxYs35BFrT-SMEjQEpXakhDQc

Hello again! I hope you are doing well. I really like all the artwork you have made for me earlier. I hope i am not making too many requests, but i really love your artstyle! Could i ask you to draw my arctic fox again? This time, please draw him wearing a different outfit. The outfit is up to you, but perhaps he could wear a light summer outfit! The pose and composition is also completely up to you. Feel free to have fun with it and draw him however you want to!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1C2_gWV9MxYs35BFrT-SMEjQEpXakhDQc

Hello! Can i ask you to please draw my fox? His personality is calm and confident. If possible, you can draw him wearing the camouflage-patterned trenchcoat included in the references, but feel free to draw him in any other outfit! The pose and composition is up to you. Thank you for considering my request!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1C2_gWV9MxYs35BFrT-SMEjQEpXakhDQc?usp=drive_link

Hello, Mikage.
My name is Kim.

If you don't mind, could you please draw our wolf girl...!
I don't have any particular requirements for costume, composition, or situation.
I love anything, whether it's cool or surprisingly maidenly.
I want you to look at our wolf girl and make her look like a suitable figure.
I like the situations and outfits that you like,
I would be very happy if you could take a look at our wolf and draw it as you like.

I am sorry that this is the first request I have received in a while that is so open-ended.
If this is okay with you, I would like to ask you to do this request again.

Thank you very much. 🙇‍♂

https://1drv.ms/f/s!Aom0SXByHDbQh_gip_9n0mTZcd2O_Q?e=VPxolM

Nice to meet you, Mr. Mikage of the Other Half, my name is Hiro.
I would like to make a request to the other half, Mr. Mikage, for a skeb.

This time, I would like you to draw my original character, "Cutthroat Sound.
I would like to see what the other half of Mikage would like to see in his drawing, so I would like to leave the clothing and situations up to you.
We would like to see the other half of the character, so we would like to leave the clothing and the situation up to you.
The jagged pattern around the belly is not a disorder of the fur, but a "pattern.

We may use your work for personal use such as social networking site icons.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-SLMDSAa5-h3RhiAb7-F7uVr-cHgz1rX
